title: Node Localization by Multidimensional Scaling with Iterative Majorization
abstract: arXiv:2611.18466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Node localization aims to estimate the positions of nodes based on collected data from other nodes. Depending on the data characteristics, different procedures are utilized to estimate the locations. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive multidimensional scaling algorithm based on iterative majorization that comprises many of the different data characteristics to estimate node locations. The implicitly normalized loss function provides absolute distances and, given anchors, absolute node locations. The algorithm uses a new convergent coordinate descent procedure for the minimization of the majorization function, allowing for a natural treatment of anchors. Optimal transformations of the data seamlessly allows other data than Euclidean distances. Data from multiple sources, resulting in either asymmetric or three-way data, fit the same extensive framework.

translated_title: 基于迭代主化多维缩放的节点定位
translated_abstract: 节点定位旨在基于从其他节点收集的数据来估计节点的位置。根据数据特征的不同，需要采用不同的方法来估计位置。本文提出了一种基于迭代主化的综合性多维缩放算法，该算法涵盖了多种不同的数据特征来估计节点位置。隐式归一化的损失函数能够提供绝对距离，并在给定锚点的情况下给出节点的绝对位置。该算法采用了一种新的收敛坐标下降过程来最小化主化函数，从而能够自然地处理锚点。通过对数据进行最优变换，非欧几里得距离等其他类型的数据也能被无缝处理。来自多个来源的数据，无论是非对称数据还是三向数据，均适用于同一广泛框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于迭代主化的综合多维缩放算法，可统一处理锚点、非欧氏距离、非对称及三向数据等多种数据特征，实现节点位置的精确估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a comprehensive multidimensional scaling algorithm based on iterative majorization that unifies various data characteristics—including anchors, non-Euclidean distances, asymmetric, and three-way data—for accurate node localization.
